summary: Completed P3 features testing for PropertyCheck AI. All P3 features working: D3.js Title Chain Visualization (horizontal animated flow), Background Jobs (5 job types with polling), Land Record Databases (17 Indian states), Payment Activation (Stripe + Razorpay toggle), Mobile Responsiveness (hamburger menu). Backend: 12/12 tests passed. Frontend: All features verified.
critical_code_review_comments: D3.js Title Chain Visualization renders SVG with animated nodes and connecting lines (1166x320 dimensions)
Background Jobs with 5 job types: risk_analysis, document_ocr, govt_data_retrieval, title_verification, valuation_report
Job polling works correctly - shows progress updates (10% -> 65% etc) with step names
Land Registries shows 17 states: Karnataka, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, AP, UP, Rajasthan, Gujarat, WB, Kerala, MP, Punjab, Haryana, Odisha, Assam, Bihar, Delhi
Primary registry (Karnataka - Bhoomi/Kaveri) highlighted with 95% digitization badge
Pricing page has Stripe (International) and Razorpay (India) payment method toggle
3 pricing tiers: Basic (₹499), Standard (₹1499), Premium (₹2999) with feature lists
Mobile hamburger menu visible at 390px viewport with slide-out navigation
Mobile nav shows 7 items: Dashboard, Search Properties, Add Property, Pricing, API Documentation, Profile, Settings
Payment Success page maintains dark theme with gradient background and glass card
PropertyDetail page has 11 tabs including new Land Records and Jobs tabs
